name: Waifu by Myside: Patch Me In
source:
A simple erotic visual novel — right up until the moment you launch it. Your dream waifu suddenly starts acting strange: watching you too closely, hiding something she shouldn’t. Now you must uncover what happened to the game — and what Candy is truly planning… 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3677020//]Steam[/url]]
